pages.fetch_note: PDF answer from Secretary of State Arkadiusz Myrcha (Ministry of Justice) to Marshal Szymon Hołownia, dated 4 Apr 2025, ref. BK-VII.0520.440.2024. In the text extraction, the Criminal Law and KKUSiP rows do not map cleanly onto the columns. The answer names no commission members.
